description: Boruto Uzumaki is the main character in the anime/manga series Boruto: Naruto Next Generations, the sequel to the popular Naruto series. He is the son of the Seventh Hokage – Naruto Uzumaki and Hinata Hyuga, carrying the blood of the two most powerful clans in the Leaf Village.
